gateSummary.disposition: The expanded local 2M recipe-phase regression remains recorded for follow-up. Thresholds are unchanged and no all-gates-pass claim is made.

scope: Three repetitions per engine/dataset. All completed OpenRefine pairs at 100k through 1M match complete output cells, row counts, facets and clusters.
At 2M rows all three OpenRefine attempts reported a JVM allocation failure with a fixed 1400M heap; no OpenRefine output equality or speed ratio is established there.
People and cardinality exported outputs were checked completely. Cardinality ran six datasets, three repetitions per build, with true backend process restart.
Database import ran 100000 rows and three columns for four backends, three repetitions each; all exported values, numeric/text/null types and fresh-process reopening were checked.
Backend restart startup/stop are recorded separately from open_project timing; filesystem caches remain warm. Workflow memory is maximum HWM across backend lifetimes, not a sum.

Windows memory uses PeakWorkingSet64 in MiB; parent Node, browser and database-service memory are excluded. Host background activity was recorded; this is not a controlled-laboratory or universal-input claim.
cleanup: Every measurement-owned OxRefine/OpenRefine backend exited. Native PostgreSQL/MySQL/MariaDB fixture services remain owned by the project coordinator for its cleanup.
